turn.user_message: Show me the changes on the wards
turn.context: Discharge sample conversation, turn 6 (playbook §4: function by function, today against with Virevo).

transcript.label: Sample conversation · turn 6 · the changes on the wards

text: Most of the work stays the same. What changes is when it starts, and who writes it. Why these changes:
bullets: Starting in the evening only works if each team knows it has started, so the software tells them.
Staff approve instead of writing, so nobody does the same work twice.
The discharge papers are the biggest hold-up today, so they change the most.
chat.invite: Next is the people who must agree, and who has the most to give up.
chat.note: Same steps. They just start the night before.

points.label: The bill and the supply count

prompts: Show me the people who must agree
Why are the papers the biggest hold-up?
One team does both discharges and admissions
chat.pointer: Switch between today and with the changes. Pick a job to open it.

blocks.title: Same steps, started the night before
blocks.deck: Each job on one clock, from the evening round to the next afternoon.

switch.cap_today: Everything waits for the 11 AM signature. The patient leaves about 3 PM.
switch.cap_with: Most of the work moves to the evening before. The morning only checks and signs.

blocks.caption: The 7 PM round and the 11 AM signature are your times. The other times are my estimate.

sheets.title: Evening round
sheets.text: Doctors already decide on the 7 PM round. Today nothing is written down, so no team can start.
sheets.entry: Who hears the decision on the round today?

sheets.title: Discharge papers
sheets.text: The papers are the biggest hold-up today, so they change the most. A ready draft is checked and signed.
sheets.entry: How long does one summary take to type?

sheets.title: Bill and supplies
sheets.text: Today nurses count supplies before billing can start. With the change, the bill is kept up to date and nurses only check.

sheets.title: Insurance
sheets.text: Today the insurer is asked only once the bill is final. With the change, a first bill goes the evening before.

sheets.title: Family and transport
sheets.text: Today the family is called late and arrives in the afternoon. With the change, they hear the leaving time that evening.
sheets.entry: When does the family hear today?

sheets.title: Admissions
sheets.text: One team runs leaving and arriving, so admissions queue behind discharges. Split the team, or run both at once. It costs nothing but the new order.
sheets.entry: Is it one team, or two?
